stanzas.sanskrit:
अजामिलो नाम महीसुरः पुरा
चरन् विभो धर्मपथान् गृहाश्रमी ।
गुरोर्गिरा काननमेत्य दृष्टवान्
सुधृष्टशीलां कुलटां मदाकुलाम् ॥ २२-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Long ago there was a Brahmin named Ajaamilan who led a virtuous life. He went to the forest for collecting sacrificial fuel at his father's request. There he met an immoral, immodest woman who was given to drinking.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ajāmilo nāma mahīsuraḥ purā
caran vibho dharmapathān gṛhāśramī |
gurorgirā kānanametya dṛṣṭavān
sudhṛṣṭaśīlāṃ kulaṭāṃ madākulām || 22-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्वतः प्रशान्तोऽपि तदाहृताशयः
स्वधर्ममुत्सृज्य तया समारमन् ।
अधर्मकारी दशमीभवन् पुन-
-र्दधौ भवन्नामयुते सुते रतिम् ॥ २२-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Though by nature a man of self control, his mind was attracted to her. He gave up all his duties and led a sinful life. As he became old, he became very much attached to his son who was named - Naaraayana.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
svataḥ praśānto’pi tadāhṛtāśayaḥ
svadharmamutsṛjya tayā samāraman |
adharmakārī daśamībhavan puna-
-rdadhau bhavannāmayute sute ratim || 22-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स मृत्युकाले यमराजकिङ्करान्
भयङ्करांस्त्रीनभिलक्षयन् भिया ।
पुरा मनाक् त्वत्स्मृतिवासनाबला-
-ज्जुहाव नारायणनामकं सुतम् ॥ २२-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: At the time of death, he saw before him three fierce looking messengers of Yama - the God of death. He called out in fright the name of his son Naaraayana, induced by the strength of the memory of his past devotion to Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sa mṛtyukāle yamarājakiṅkarān
bhayaṅkarāṃstrīnabhilakṣayan bhiyā |
purā manāk tvatsmṛtivāsanābalā-
-jjuhāva nārāyaṇanāmakaṃ sutam || 22-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दुराशयस्यापि तदात्मनिर्गत-
त्वदीयनामाक्षरमात्रवैभवात् ।
पुरोऽभिपेतुर्भवदीयपार्षदा-
-श्चतुर्भुजाः पीतपटा मनोहराः ॥ २२-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: In spite of his evil nature, by the glory of the letters of Bhagwan’s name uttered by him, there appeared before him, the messengers of Bhagwan. They had four arms and were wearing yellow robes and were of enchanting appearance.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
durāśayasyāpi tadātmanirgata-
tvadīyanāmākṣaramātravaibhavāt |
puro’bhipeturbhavadīyapārṣadā-
-ścaturbhujāḥ pītapaṭā manoharāḥ || 22-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अमुं च सम्पाश्य विकर्षतो भटान्
विमुञ्चतेत्यारुरुधुर्बलादमी ।
निवारितास्ते च भवज्जनैस्तदा
तदीयपापं निखिलं न्यवेदयन् ॥ २२-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Seeing Ajaamilan tied up with ropes and being dragged by the messengers of Yama, they were obstructed by Vishnu Dhuthas by force and were stopped to do so. Then the messengers of Yama narrate all his sins.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
amuṃ ca sampāśya vikarṣato bhaṭān
vimuñcatetyārurudhurbalādamī |
nivāritāste ca bhavajjanaistadā
tadīyapāpaṃ nikhilaṃ nyavedayan || 22-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भवन्तु पापानि कथं तु निष्कृते
कृतेऽपि भो दण्डनमस्ति पण्डिताः ।
न निष्कृतिः किं विदिता भवादृशा-
-मिति प्रभो त्वत्पुरुषा बभाषिरे ॥ २२-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Vishnu Dhuthas told them that even if there were sins, how was it that there was punishment when atonement had been made. Did people like them who were learned, not know what atone
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhavantu pāpāni kathaṃ tu niṣkṛte
kṛte’pi bho daṇḍanamasti paṇḍitāḥ |
na niṣkṛtiḥ kiṃ viditā bhavādṛśā-
-miti prabho tvatpuruṣā babhāṣire || 22-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यां विहिता व्रतादयः
पुनन्ति पापं न लुनन्ति वासनाम् ।
अनन्तसेवा तु निकृन्तति द्वयी-
-मिति प्रभो त्वत्पुरुषा बभाषिरे ॥ २२-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrutismṛtibhyāṃ vihitā vratādayaḥ
punanti pāpaṃ na lunanti vāsanām |
anantasevā tu nikṛntati dvayī-
-miti prabho tvatpuruṣā babhāṣire || 22-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अनेन भो जन्मसहस्रकोटिभिः
कृतेषु पापेष्वपि निष्कृतिः कृता ।
यदग्रहीन्नाम भयाकुलो हरे-
-रिति प्रभो त्वत्पुरुषा बभाषिरे ॥ २२-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Vishnu Dhuthas told the messengers of Yama that though overcome by fear, Ajaamil had uttered the Name of Hari. By that alone he had atoned for all the sins committed by him in innumerable lives.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
anena bho janmasahasrakoṭibhiḥ
kṛteṣu pāpeṣvapi niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā |
yadagrahīnnāma bhayākulo hare-
-riti prabho tvatpuruṣā babhāṣire || 22-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नृणामबुद्ध्यापि मुकुन्दकीर्तनं
दहत्यघौघान् महिमास्य तादृशः ।
यथाग्निरेधांसि यथौषधं गदा-
-निति प्रभो त्वत्पुरुषा बभाषिरे ॥ २२-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nṛṇāmabuddhyāpi mukundakīrtanaṃ
dahatyaghaughān mahimāsya tādṛśaḥ |
yathāgniredhāṃsi yathauṣadhaṃ gadā-
-niti prabho tvatpuruṣā babhāṣire || 22-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इतीरितैर्याम्यभटैरपासृते
भवद्भटानां च गणे तिरोहिते ।
भवत् स्मृतिं कञ्चन कालमाचरन्
भवत् पदं प्रापि भवद्भटैरसौ ॥ २२-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The messengers of Yama left after hearing all of this. Vishnu Dhuthas also disappeared. Ajaamilan remembered and worshipped Bhagwan and then attained Bhagwan’s abode led by Vishnu Dhuthas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
itīritairyāmyabhaṭairapāsṛte
bhavadbhaṭānāṃ ca gaṇe tirohite |
bhavat smṛtiṃ kañcana kālamācaran
bhavat padaṃ prāpi bhavadbhaṭairasau || 22-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्वकिङ्करावेदनशङ्कितो यम-
-स्त्वदङ्घ्रिभक्तेषु न गम्यतामिति ।
स्वकीयभृत्यानशिशिक्षदुच्चकैः
स देव वातालयनाथ पाहि माम् ॥ २२-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Yama was very much concerned at the report of his messengers. He strictly instructed them not to go to the devotees of Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
svakiṅkarāvedanaśaṅkito yama-
-stvadaṅghribhakteṣu na gamyatāmiti |
svakīyabhṛtyānaśiśikṣaduccakaiḥ
sa deva vātālayanātha pāhi mām || 22-11 ||
